title: Dedicated, accessible space for the dwelling's waste bins per local government requirements
text: A dedicated and accessible space is provided to accommodate the required number and type of waste storage bins for the dwelling, in line with requirements of the local government.

replaces.note: 'for the development' -> 'for the dwelling'; separation from non-residential waste in mixed use dropped

notes: from: ch3 C2.4.1 (evaluator unchanged). Register C4P1-050: the mixed-use separation words are dropped and 'for the dwelling' replaces 'for the development', which changes the scope for apartments sharing a bin store; not in the ToC.
